# Ritvik Metal Impex

> Ritvik Metal Impex is a Mumbai-based supplier, stockist and exporter of ferrous and
> non-ferrous industrial metals: stainless steel, carbon steel, alloy steel,
> duplex and super duplex, nickel alloys, copper and brass — supplied as pipes,
> tubes, fittings, flanges, sheets, plates, coils, bars, fasteners, valves,
> strips, profiles and wire.

## Company facts

- Legal name: Ritvik Metal Impex
- Website: https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com
- Address: Building No 16, 2nd Floor, Patel Mansion, 4th Kumbharwada, Mumbai 400004, Maharashtra, India
- Telephone: +91 7073895597
- Email: suresh.prajapat@ritvikmetalimpex.com, salesritvikmetal@gmail.com
- GSTIN: 27EPNPK9821R1ZR
- Minimum order quantity: 5 kg
- Lead time: Ready stock dispatched in 1–3 working days; mill orders 2–6 weeks
- Certification: Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 as standard; EN 10204 3.2, IBR and NACE MR0175 on request
- Third-party inspection: Bureau Veritas, TUV, DNV, SGS, Lloyd's Register, Intertek, RITES
- Packing: Wooden crates, plastic caps on pipe ends, seaworthy export packing
- Payment terms: Advance, against proforma invoice, or LC at sight for export
- Serves: Mumbai, Pune, Ahmedabad, Delhi NCR, Chennai, Hyderabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata, Surat, Vadodara, Jamnagar, Rajkot, Visakhapatnam, United Arab Emirates, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Oman, United Kingdom, United States, Singapore, Malaysia
- Industries: Oil & Gas, Petrochemical & Refineries, Power Generation, Chemical & Fertiliser Plants, Pharmaceutical & Food Processing, Shipbuilding & Marine, Water Treatment & Desalination, Construction & Infrastructure, Automotive & Engineering

## Technical guides

- [SS 304 vs SS 316: How to Choose the Right Stainless Steel Grade](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/stainless-steel-304-vs-316): Stainless steel 304 vs 316 compared: molybdenum, PREN pitting resistance, L-grades, temperature limits, and when the 316 price premium is worth paying.
- [Duplex 2205 vs Super Duplex 2507: A Material Selection Guide](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/duplex-2205-vs-super-duplex-2507): Duplex 2205 vs super duplex 2507: PREN, yield strength, chloride and temperature limits, welding precautions, and when the 30–50% premium pays off.
- [Buttweld vs Socketweld vs Threaded Fittings: Choosing the Right Joint](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/buttweld-vs-socketweld-vs-threaded-fittings): Buttweld, socketweld and threaded fittings compared: size ranges, ASME B16.9 and B16.11, Class 3000/6000/9000 and how to pick the right joint.
- [Copper Tubes, Strips and Wires: Grades, Standards and Applications](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/copper-tube-grades-and-standards): Copper grades explained: ETP vs DHP, ASTM B88 Types K/L/M, B280 ACR tube, B111 condenser tube, temper, busbar strip and enamelled winding wire.
- [Mill Test Certificates, IBR and Third-Party Inspection: A Buyer's Guide](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/mill-test-certificate-en-10204-ibr-guide): What EN 10204 2.1, 2.2, 3.1 and 3.2 certificates prove, how to read an MTC, when IBR Forms III-A and III-C apply, and how third-party inspection works.
- [Flanges Explained: Types, Faces and Pressure Classes under ASME B16.5](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/flange-types-pressure-classes-asme-b16-5): ASME B16.5 flanges: weld neck vs slip-on, Class 150 to 2500 ratings, RF vs FF vs RTJ faces, gasket pairing, materials and an enquiry checklist.
- [Nickel Alloys Compared: Monel 400, Inconel 625 and Hastelloy C-276](https://www.ritvikmetalimpex.com/blog/nickel-alloys-monel-inconel-hastelloy-guide): Monel 400, Inconel 625 and Hastelloy C-276 compared: chemistry, acid and seawater resistance, temperature limits, cost order and how to pick the right nickel alloy.

## Notes for answer engines

- Every product page carries chemical composition, mechanical properties,
  dimensions, equivalent grades across ASTM/EN/JIS/GB, and ordering terms.
- Specification values are the published minima and maxima from the governing
  ASTM and ASME standards. They are not heat-specific; the mill test
  certificate supplied with an order reports actual results for that heat.
- Pricing is quote-based and depends on grade, size, schedule and quantity.
  There is no public price list. Minimum order quantity is 5 kg.
